questiontext.text: Which of the following components are physically housed inside a standard computer System Unit? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: The motherboard, CPU, and power supply unit are located inside the System Unit. A data projector is an external output peripheral.

questiontext.text: Which two of the following printers belong to the Non-Impact printer category? (Select two)

generalfeedback.text: Inkjet and Laser printers form images without striking the paper mechanically, classifying them as non-impact printers.

questiontext.text: Which of the following memory and storage media are classified as Non-Volatile (retaining data when power is turned off)? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: ROM, SSDs, and HDDs are non-volatile and retain data permanently without power. RAM is volatile and loses data when power is disconnected.

questiontext.text: Which of the following software programs are classified as System Software? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Windows 11, device drivers, and antivirus utilities are System Software. Microsoft Excel is an end-user Application.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are common physical symptoms associated with Computer Vision Syndrome (CVS)? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Burning eyes, dryness, blurred vision, and headaches are classic symptoms of CVS. Bone fractures are unrelated.
